notes: Only configured Ethereum v4 PoolIds plus IMD/UNLK transfers are indexed. Other pools/chains are outside coverage.
Startup begins with at most 1,800 confirmed blocks. Selectable periods are clipped to indexed history; absent rows are not proof of no activity.
Swaps, plain transfers and liquidity operations are separate. Router/PoolManager balances are never assigned to traders.
Wallet attribution requires a transaction sender and matching token transfer direction. Aggregators and unknown executors remain unattributed.
Watchlist: up to 10 larger IMD balances among at most 24 observed EOA counterparties, plus the declared treasury candidate; contract custody and global holder rankings are outside coverage.
No wallet identities, cost basis, profit or investment quality are inferred.
Block timestamp request quota reached; older rows in this scan are omitted.
The bundled export retains 60 latest actual events from the prior observation. Older events are omitted; this is a dated sample, not a complete or live feed.
